strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle. On the 1-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then wait for price to retest the fair value gap and for the retest candle to be engulfed before entering in the breakout direction.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the deepest trade into the fair value gap with one tick of breathing room, and take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target. No active management after entry.

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_limit_reentry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then place a limit order on the fair value gap so entry occurs automatically when price trades back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the first candle of the fair value gap pattern, and take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target. No active management after entry aside from letting the trade play out.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct strategies: a scalping FVG retest/engulfing entry with 3:1 target, and a day-trading FVG limit-entry variant with different opening-range timeframe, confirmation mechanic, and target; the transcript presents them as separate strategy entries.
